prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1385; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under any policy that may apply to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data, repair and total-loss records, telematics or dash camera footage, and all claim notes. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while the claim is open.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
